steps.title: Client books
steps.text: Admin › Client books: each card is one client company’s AutoCount book and the bridge that serves it.
steps.label: Add client book

steps.title: A new client book
steps.text: Its name and its AutoCount database. With “Set up its bridge automatically” ticked, nobody builds the bridge by hand.
steps.label: Add

steps.title: The bridge builds itself
steps.text: A set-up service on the AutoCount server claims the book, builds its bridge, installs it as a service and enrols it with a single-use code, reporting each step here.
steps.label: Next

steps.title: Ready
steps.text: The new book’s bridge has polled the app: the book is ready, and no key was typed by anyone.

steps.title: Upload
steps.text: Upload takes PDFs, photos, ZIPs or a whole folder. Mixed batch works out what each document is.
steps.label: Mixed batch

steps.title: One ZIP, a month of documents
steps.text: A ZIP of five made-up documents: invoices, a sales invoice, a payment voucher and a bank slip.
steps.label: Read 1 file

steps.title: Sorted into lanes
steps.text: Every page read by AI and sorted: three invoices (one of them a sales invoice) and two payments. Nothing is posted yet.
steps.label: File 5

steps.title: The review queue
steps.text: The new documents are waiting. One is tagged AR Invoice: the app spotted a sales invoice among the bills.
steps.label: View

steps.title: A sales invoice, recognised
steps.text: Detected as an invoice to a customer (AR), and the customer matched by name, 100%: LUMINA RETAIL SDN BHD.

steps.title: A supplier, recognised
steps.text: Printed as “Metro Power Bhd”, matched to the supplier on file: METRO POWER BERHAD.

steps.title: One invoice, opened
steps.text: The document on the left, what the AI read on the right: supplier matched, numbers and dates filled.
steps.label: Line items

steps.title: Coded from history
steps.text: Every line already has an account, “as on PI-000118”: how this supplier was posted before. A saved rule or the AI fills any gap.

steps.title: Ready to post
steps.text: The server’s verdict: nothing left to fill in. Post stays disabled until it says so.
steps.label: Post to AutoCount

steps.title: Posted
steps.text: The bridge posted it into AutoCount, which numbered it PI-000123.
steps.label: Posted

steps.title: Read back: Verified
steps.text: After posting, the app reads the invoice back out of AutoCount and checks it.
steps.label: Compare

steps.title: Sent vs stored
steps.text: Field by field, what was sent beside what AutoCount stored: all 19 fields match.
steps.label: Review

steps.chapter: A payment linked to its invoice
steps.title: Payments and supporting documents
steps.text: The ZIP’s payment voucher and bank slip, each waiting to be matched to what it pays.
steps.label: PV-0458

steps.chapter: A payment linked to its invoice
steps.title: Money out, for GS-INV-2611-045
steps.text: Read as money out from Northwind, naming the invoice it pays. Ask AutoCount what this supplier still owes.
steps.label: Request open items

steps.chapter: A payment linked to its invoice
steps.title: The knock-off, suggested
steps.text: The invoice it names is already ticked: 512.40 knocked off, nothing left unapplied.
steps.label: Confirm knock-off

steps.chapter: A payment linked to its invoice
steps.title: Paid from the bank account
steps.text: Confirmed. Paid by: the Maybank account, one of AutoCount’s payment methods for this book.
steps.label: Post payment

steps.chapter: A payment linked to its invoice
steps.title: Confirm
steps.text: One last check before it is written into the client’s books.
steps.label: Post

steps.chapter: A payment linked to its invoice
steps.title: Payment posted
steps.text: AutoCount recorded the payment as PV-000058 and knocked it off invoice PI-000123.
